verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question for an identity SaaS platform, but the pack has no evidence of API versioning (e.g., a versioned Management API) or a published deprecation policy. The 'versioned' Actions mention (auth0-docs-52) describes versioning of customer-written functions, and the Rules/Hooks-to-Actions migration page (auth0-docs-83) is a migration guide; both are adjacent features and don't count. The OpenAPI probe (auth0-probe-3) also returned 404s, so there is no machine-readable versioned spec.
